tracks.title: Chasing the Sun
tracks.loreNote: An upbeat, triumphant 80s heartland rock anthem capturing the optimistic bond of four best friends chasing the sunset.

tracks.title: My Anchor
tracks.loreNote: A heartfelt 80s power ballad reflecting Leo's profound platonic love and trust for his best friend, Olivia.

tracks.title: The Boy Inside
tracks.loreNote: A fierce, protective power ballad from Olivia's perspective, seeing Leo's true brilliance beyond his disability.

tracks.title: The DeMarco Decree
tracks.loreNote: A high school rock anthem featuring a poignant flute interlude that represents Leo and Luna's private check-in signal.

tracks.title: Radio Waves
tracks.loreNote: A high-energy, classic 80s FM radio hit celebrating late-night mixtape creation and youthful optimism.

tracks.title: Guiding Stars
tracks.loreNote: The massive, triumphant 80s arena rock title track celebrating family, friendship, and unadulterated joy.

tracks.title: The House on Lisa Court
tracks.loreNote: A New Wave-influenced rock anthem expressing profound gratitude for the safe home Stella built.

tracks.title: Two-Part Time
tracks.loreNote: An observational New Wave track highlighting the perfect, unspoken communication between Leo, Luna, and Stella.

tracks.title: The House on Lisa Court (Alternate Take)
tracks.loreNote: Bonus track. An alternate studio recording of the New Wave tribute.
